units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:2">Toh. IX, 2</cite> <he>המ׳ היוצא מהן</he> the fluid which runs out of the olives (before they are pressed); <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:3">ib. 3</cite> <he>המ׳ היוצא מהן</he> that which runs (after the oil is pressed out); <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:3">ib.</cite> <he>היוצא מן הבור</he> which comes out of the pit after the oil has been taken out; Tosef. ib. X, 3 <he>מ׳ היוצא מעיקת בית הבד</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 6:5">Makhsh. VI, 5</cite> <he>אין המ׳ יוצא מידי שמן</he>; Tosef. l. c. <he>ידי צחצוחי שומן</he> (read: <cite ref="U01496"><he>שמן</he></cite>) the secretion (of olives) cannot be excluded from the category of (must be classified with) (diluted) oil; <cite ref="Shabbat 144a">Sabb. 144ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="R00280"><he>צִחְצוּחַ</he></cite>; a. fr.
